module.purpose: This file implements the authenticated booking decision workflow, coordinating confirmation or rejection, persistence, payments, notifications, webhooks, audit events, and rejection workflows across the scheduling system.
module.summary: The handler retrieves a booking with its event, organizer, attendees, payment, recurring-event, and assignment data, then verifies organizer access and validates request state. Confirmation builds a calendar event payload, resolves credentials, and delegates calendar-related processing. Rejection updates one or multiple recurring bookings, refunds payments when applicable, sends declined communications, emits audit and webhook events, and schedules workflow actions. Translation caching, tracing, feature checks, and platform-client metadata support the surrounding integrations.
module.businessContext: This supports appointment and meeting approval operations in a scheduling platform. Failure can leave bookings incorrectly confirmed or rejected, payments unresolved, attendees uninformed, or downstream integrations unsynchronized.

detail.name: fireRejectionEvent
detail.signature: async function fireRejectionEvent({ actor, organizationId, actionSource, rejectedBookings, rejectionReason, isBookingAuditEnabled, tracingLogger, }: { actor: Actor; organizationId: number | null; rejectionReason: string | null; actionSource: ValidActionSource; rejectedBookings: { uid: string; oldStatus: BookingStatus; }[]; isBookingAuditEnabled: boolean; tracingLogger: ISimpleLogger; }): Promise<void>
preconditions: rejectedBookings is an array (possibly empty) of objects with uid:string and oldStatus:BookingStatus.
tracingLogger is provided for error reporting on failure.
postconditions: If rejectedBookings.length > 1, bookingEventHandlerService.onBulkBookingsRejected has been awaited with mapped booking payloads and a fresh uuidv4 operationId.
If rejectedBookings.length === 1, bookingEventHandlerService.onBookingRejected has been awaited for that single booking.
If rejectedBookings is empty, no handler call is made.
The returned promise resolves to undefined regardless of internal handler success/failure (errors are swallowed and logged).
invariants: For each rejected booking, the audit status always transitions from oldStatus to BookingStatus.REJECTED.
The bulk path generates a single shared uuidv4 operationId covering all bookings in that call.
Actor and organizationId are passed through to the handler unchanged.
edgeCases: rejectedBookings.length === 0: no handler is invoked; function returns undefined.
rejectedBookings.length === 1: invokes single-booking onBookingRejected using rejectedBookings[0].
rejectedBookings.length > 1: invokes bulk onBulkBookingsRejected; each booking.uid is mapped to bookingUid and each oldStatus to auditData.status.old.

Any thrown error from getBookingEventHandlerService or from the handler service calls is caught and the promise still fulfills; the error is logged via tracingLogger.error with message 'Error firing booking rejection event' and a safeStringify-serialized error payload.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No validation/throw on input shape; handlers may throw internally but exceptions are caught and logged via tracingLogger.error.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Promise<void> — always resolves; internal failures are swallowed and recorded via tracingLogger.error.

eventsEmitted: tracingLogger.error('Error firing booking rejection event', safeStringify(error)) on caught exceptions

detail.signature: export const confirmHandler = async ({ ctx, input }: ConfirmOptions) =>
preconditions: input.bookingId is a valid booking id
prisma is connected and BookingAccessService is instantiable
postconditions: On confirmed path with unpaid payment: booking status is updated to BookingStatus.ACCEPTED and { message: 'Booking confirmed', status: BookingStatus.ACCEPTED } is returned
On confirmed path with paid/no-payment: handleConfirmation is invoked with built CalendarEvent and credentials; returns { message: 'Booking confirmed', status: BookingStatus.ACCEPTED }

On rejection path: booking status is updated to BookingStatus.REJECTED (single or bulk for recurring), refunds processed if payment exists, decline emails/SMS sent if emailsEnabled, rejection audit event fired, BOOKING_REJECTED webhook triggered, and BOOKING_REJECTED workflows scheduled; returns { message: 'Booking rejected', status: BookingStatus.REJECTED }
On already-accepted booking: throws before any mutation
invariants: Authorization check (doesUserIdHaveAccessToBooking) always runs before status-reveal checks
Already-accepted guard runs after authorization but before any state change
Recurring event id validation (if provided) runs before confirmation/rejection side effects
Translations are cached per locale within a single invocation via a Map
edgeCases: Booking has no user (user is null): throws TRPCError { code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Booking must have an organizer' }
Caller is not authorized for the booking: throws TRPCError { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'User is not authorized to confirm this booking' }
Booking status is already BookingStatus.ACCEPTED: throws TRPCError { code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Booking already confirmed' }
confirmed=true with payment.length>0 and !paid: skips full confirmation pipeline, updates status to ACCEPTED directly, returns early
recurringEventId provided but no booking matches both recurringEventId and booking.id: throws TRPCError { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Recurring event id doesn't belong to the booking' }
booking.location is empty/null: getLocationValueForDB receives empty string fallback
booking.userPrimaryEmail and booking.user.email both missing: organizer email falls back to 'Email-less'
booking.user.name missing: organizer name falls back to 'Nameless'
booking.user.locale missing: translation locale falls back to 'en'
booking.eventType is null/undefined: many eventType fields default to undefined/false/null gracefully
workflows scheduling throws: caught and logged via console.error, execution continues

detail.summary: Given a ConfirmOptions payload, this handler either confirms or rejects a booking: it authorizes the caller, validates the booking state, and routes to confirmation (with credential/wallet handling) or rejection (with refund, email/SMS, audit event, webhook, and workflow dispatch), returning a message and final BookingStatus.
